description:
Lunalis Cosmetics — a luxury clean brand that serves the anti-aging skincare market with an approach that we call “skinamalism” - all while expanding women’s opportunities.
 
Skinamalism: Our results are derived from stripped back formulas containing the healthiest essentials (antioxidants, probiotics, collagen-boosting amino acids) and nothing more. Our secret? Prickly Pear Seed Oil -a Moroccan native hero ingredient and a desert-tested hydrator. As a result of our minimalistic approach, our skincare does more with less and supports four different problem areas: adult acne, wrinkles, sun damage and sensitive skin. Skincare is healthcare and that’s why we choose non-comedogenic ingredients that strengthen the skin’s microbiome and avoid irritation, while being kind to our health.
